section_summary.extract_value: This is a 'Measures' section describing the assessment instruments used in the study. The section details four main instruments: the Social Safeness and Pleasure Scale (SSPS) for assessing positive social emotions, the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) for measuring body image appreciation and acceptance, the Inflexible Eating Questionnaire (IEQ) for assessing rigid eating rules, and the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q) for evaluating eating disorder pathology. BMI was calculated from self-reported weight and height using the Quetelet index. No participant demographics, sample size, or correlation results are provided in this section.
